name: The Great Hall of the Paris Cauldron

exhibits.title: The Paris Cauldron
exhibits.text: A great iron cauldron bearing a Parisian seal, in which the whole JEPA realm simmers as of May 2026. Into it have gone the Mirror of Occlusion (the architecture) and the Three Vows (the loss); out of it now rise V-JEPA 2 bound to robot arms, the new Paris house of AMI Labs founded by LeCun himself, WorldLabs' generative Marble across the sea, and the winter-born World Action Models. The lecture given over this cauldron holds one thesis: by the clock of the transformer era, the JEPA paradigm stands today where language models stood at their GPT-3 moment — the ChatGPT-equivalent has not yet arrived, but it is no longer absurd to expect it.

exhibits.title: V-JEPA 2 and 2.1: The Mirror Learns to Act
exhibits.text: At the Meta enclave, the Mirror became V-JEPA. V-JEPA 2 (June 2025) drank one million hours of internet video, then was schooled on a mere sixty-two hours of robot data — and from that diet learned to grasp objects it had never seen, at sixty-five to eighty percent success on the Franka arm. V-JEPA 2.1 (March 2026) added a Dense Predictive Loss (every token contributes to the learning signal, not only the masked ones), Deep Self-Supervision (hierarchical losses at intermediate encoder layers), and modality-specific tokenizers — lifting grasping success by twenty percentage points and making planning tenfold faster. Released in four sizes: ViT-g and ViT-G at one and two billion parameters; distilled ViT-B and ViT-L at eighty and three hundred million.

exhibits.title: New Houses of the Realm
exhibits.text: In PARIS, the heterodox wizard LeCun departed Meta to found AMI Labs: a seed round of $1.03 billion (March 2026) — the largest ever recorded in European wizardry — at a $3.5 billion valuation; Alexandre LeBrun (ex-Meta FAIR, ex-Nabla) as chief executive, Saining Xie (ResNeXt, ConvNeXt) as chief scientist; world models built explicitly on the JEPA architecture, pledged open-source. In CALIFORNIA, Fei-Fei Li's WorldLabs shipped Marble (November 2025): not prediction in representation space but GENERATION of persistent, downloadable 3D worlds from text, image, video, or sketch — rendered as Gaussian Splatting, clouds of soft elliptical motes with color, opacity and orientation. The irenic framing: generative models like Marble will create the worlds in which predictive agents like V-JEPA shall be trained.

exhibits.title: The World Action Models
exhibits.text: The newest twist, born this past winter: WORLD ACTION MODELS (WAMs). Rather than train perception and action separately and bolt them together as the VLA tradition does, a single model jointly generates BOTH future video AND future action. DreamZero (NVIDIA, February 2026): a 14-billion-parameter video diffusion transformer with flow matching, jointly denoising video and action latents — 62.2% on seen tasks versus 27.4% for the best VLA baseline, 39.5% versus 16.3% unseen, running at 7 Hz closed-loop after a 38-fold inference optimization. Fast-WAM (Tsinghua/Galaxea) then discovered one need not imagine the video at test time at all: the video-prediction objective matters DURING TRAINING, as representational enrichment — analogous to BERT's masked tokens. MotuBrain (ShengShu, April 2026), a Mixture-of-Transformers, scored 95.8% on RoboTwin 2.0 with a 13.5-fold data-efficiency gain.

exhibits.title: The Visiting Lecturer of Paris
exhibits.subtitle: On why the cauldron has not yet boiled over
exhibits.text: Why has the JEPA paradigm not exploded as the LLM paradigm did? Four answers, my friends. First: JEPA produces no artifact a user can hold — representations are the infrastructure of intelligence, not its visible product. Second: there are no scaling laws yet; language had the Chinchilla decree of twenty tokens per parameter, and from that day the field knew how to spend its galleons — JEPA has no such decree. Third: the benchmarks were not ready; V-JEPA 2 had to ship its own. Fourth: LeCun positioned JEPA as a bet AGAINST large language models, in the very years those models delivered the most commercially successful artifacts in history. And yet — Attention in seventeen, GPT-3 three years out, ChatGPT at five; I-JEPA in twenty-three, robots at two years, a billion-galleon house at three. We stand at the GPT-3 moment of this paradigm. Study your mirrors. The realm is being built quickly.

exhibits.title: Chapter 4: The Paris Cauldron and the State of the JEPA Realm
exhibits.text:
It was during the Wandlore Symposium of the spring term that the visiting lecturer, an old wizard with a silver beard and a French inflection, addressed the assembled scholars in the Great Hall about the present state of predictive-architecture sorcery across the wizarding world.

"You have all heard," he began, "of the Mirror of Occlusion that hangs in your Hall of Predictive Sight, and you have read of the Vicereg Twins in the Charms corridor. These are the *architecture* and the *loss function* — the bone and the marrow of joint-embedding predictive sorcery. But sorcery, my dear friends, is not only theory. It is institutions. It is funding. It is — and here he allowed himself a small smile — it is *who has hired whom*."

He lifted a long scroll and unrolled it across the lectern. "Allow me to read you the landscape of the realm as it stands in this month of May, in the year twenty hundred and twenty-six.

"At the great Meta enclave, where the original Mirror was forged, the work has continued under the name V-JEPA. Last June they unveiled V-JEPA 2, the first version of the mirror that could be bound to a robotic arm and made to act upon the world. It had drunk deep of one million hours of internet video — a thousand thousand hours of pure observation — and was then briefly schooled on a mere sixty-two hours of robot data. From that diet, it learned to grasp objects it had never seen, with a success rate between sixty-five and eighty percent on the Franka arm [[ref:vjepa2_2025]]. And only this past March, V-JEPA 2.1 followed — with a *Dense Predictive Loss*, in which every token contributes to the learning signal rather than only the masked ones; a *Deep Self-Supervision* that placed hierarchical losses at intermediate encoder layers; and modality-specific tokenizers. The grasping success rose by twenty percentage points over its predecessor, and the planning ran tenfold faster [[ref:vjepa21_2026]]. They released the mirror in four sizes — the colossal ViT-g and ViT-G at one and two billion parameters, and the slender distilled ViT-B and ViT-L at eighty million and three hundred million respectively."

He set the scroll aside and lifted a second, this one bearing a Parisian seal.

"But the most remarkable news of the season has not come from Meta. In Paris — *Paris*, mind you, not the American coast — a new house has been founded. Its founder is none other than the heterodox wizard LeCun himself, who departed Meta to build a new enclave called AMI Labs. In March, they raised one billion and thirty million galleons in a *seed round* — the largest seed ever recorded in European wizardry. Their valuation is three and a half billion. The chief executive is Alexandre LeBrun, lately of Meta FAIR and of the healing-spell firm Nabla; the chief scientist is Saining Xie, the inventor of ResNeXt and ConvNeXt. They have committed themselves explicitly to building world models upon the JEPA architecture, with applications in industrial automatons, in healing magic, and in scientific divination. And — most notably for our students — they have pledged to keep their work open-source [[ref:ami2026]]."

A murmur ran through the hall. The old lecturer lifted his hand for quiet.

"There is more. Across the sea, in California, the enchantress Fei-Fei Li has built a different sort of edifice. Her company, WorldLabs, released last November a commercial artifact named Marble. Marble does not predict in representation space, as our Mirror does — Marble *generates* persistent, downloadable three-dimensional worlds from a few words of description, or an image, or a video, or even the crudest sketch of a layout. The representation it produces is Gaussian Splatting — clouds of soft elliptical motes, each with its own color and opacity and orientation, which together render a navigable scene from any chosen viewpoint. There is no technical manuscript yet. The framing offered is irenic: *generative models like Marble will create the worlds in which agents equipped with predictive models like V-JEPA shall be trained* [[ref:marble2025]]. As of this month, they are reportedly in talks to raise five hundred million galleons at a valuation of five billion."

He paused to sip from a goblet of pumpkin juice, then resumed.

"And now I come to the newest twist in the tale — a paradigm that emerged only this past winter, and which the wizarding press has taken to calling *World Action Models*, or WAMs. The principle is this: rather than train a perception model and an action model separately and bolt them together — as the older VLA tradition does — one trains a single model to jointly generate *both* the future video *and* the future action. The first was DreamZero from NVIDIA, released in February — a fourteen-billion-parameter video diffusion transformer with flow matching, jointly denoising video and action latents. It scored sixty-two point two percent on seen tasks, against twenty-seven point four for the best VLA baseline, and thirty-nine point five on unseen tasks against sixteen point three. It runs at seven hertz closed-loop, after a thirty-eight-fold inference optimization [[ref:dreamzero2026]]. Then came Fast-WAM from Tsinghua and Galaxea, which made a striking discovery: one need not actually *imagine* the video at test time. What matters is the video prediction objective *during training* — as a representational enrichment mechanism, analogous to BERT's masked token reconstruction in language [[ref:fastwam2026]]. And in April, ShengShu's MotuBrain — a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture — scored ninety-five point eight percent on RoboTwin 2.0 with a thirteen-and-a-half-fold data efficiency improvement [[ref:motubrain2026]]."

The lecturer set the scroll down and looked out over the hall.

"Now you may be wondering — if I-JEPA was first described in January of twenty-three, why has the JEPA paradigm not exploded across the wizarding economy the way the LLM paradigm did? I have asked myself this question many evenings, and I offer four answers.

"*First*: JEPA produces no artifact a user can hold. It produces *representations* — the infrastructure of intelligence, not its visible product. A young witch cannot show her parents what V-JEPA wrote, the way she can show them what ChatGPT wrote.

"*Second*: there are no scaling laws yet. For language models, the Chinchilla decree [[ref:chinchilla2022]] established the optimal ratio of twenty tokens per parameter, and from that day the field knew how to spend its galleons. JEPA has no such decree. Its scaling behavior remains under investigation.

"*Third*: the benchmark ecosystem was not ready. V-JEPA 2 had to ship its own new benchmarks alongside the model, because the existing ones were either saturated or misaligned with what the architecture was actually good at.

"*Fourth*: LeCun himself positioned JEPA as a *bet against* large language models — and during the very years of that bet, large language models delivered the most commercially successful magical artifacts in history. The heterodoxy of the framing slowed adoption, even where the technical merits would have justified it."

He smiled then, more to himself than to the hall, and lifted his goblet.

"And yet — consider the timeline. The Attention paper was published in twenty-seventeen. GPT-2 followed in twenty-nineteen, two years later. GPT-3 in twenty-twenty, three years out. ChatGPT in twenty-twenty-two, five years out. Now look at JEPA: I-JEPA in twenty-three; V-JEPA 2 in robot deployment in twenty-twenty-five, two years out; AMI Labs at one billion in twenty-twenty-six, three years out. We are, my friends, at the equivalent of the twenty-twenty GPT-3 moment in the JEPA paradigm. The ChatGPT-equivalent — whatever it shall be — has not yet arrived. But it is no longer absurd to expect it."

He set down the goblet. "Study your mirrors, my dears. Study your three sisters. Study your soft shields. The realm is being built around you, and it is being built quickly."
